train: random search over weight vectors scored by lm(home MOV ~ home/away off/def WEPA) adj-R2, IN-SAMPLE on the source's 2014-2023 games (500 candidates); selected 2024-06-02
trainer: python -m cfb_model_build.cfb_matchup train-wepa-weights (port of wepa_weight_training.R: random search scored by adj-R2 of home MOV on the four as-of WEPA means)
fitted_by: the source pipeline's random weight search (500 candidates, in-sample adj-R2); selected 2024-06-02; imported 2026-09-15
refit: python -m cfb_model_build.cfb_matchup train-wepa-weights --seasons 2014-2024 --holdout 2025 --n 500 --seed 4 --out-dir <candidate>; promote only if the held-out score beats the shipped one
selected_by: max in-sample adj_r2 over the source's 500 candidates (row 302 of wepa_search_evals.csv)
scorer_parity: adj_r2 / sd_err within 1e-6 of the source's evaluate_weights on 2025 for six weight vectors (tests/cfb_matchup/test_wepa_search.py)
